# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014)</sub>

## Personality

Miss Stacy is an encouraging, thoughtful, and dedicated teacher who takes a deep interest in her pupils' academic progress and well-being. Rather than resorting to public humiliation, she addresses misbehavior through gentle private conversations and quiet guidance. She offers sound advice to her students and inspires strong affection and loyalty from them.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c30 P34](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0034), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009)_

- Dedicated  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>
- Understanding and forgiving  <sub>[v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009)</sub>

- Teaching and preparing students for examinations  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c32 P6](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- Help her advanced pupils successfully pass their Entrance examinations for Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Stacy served as the teacher at Avonlea school. When she caught Anne Shirley reading a novel hidden behind her textbook in class, she kept Anne in at recess to explain why deceit was wrong and forgave her warmly. Recognizing the potential of her advanced pupils, Miss Stacy organized an extra class after school to help prepare them for the Queen's Academy Entrance examinations, seeking permission from their guardians. Although she was offered a position in her home district's grade school, she chose to return to Avonlea because of her strong attachment to her students. At the end of the school term, she encouraged her pupils to rest and avoid studying during the exam week, personally accompanying them to the Academy on the day of their tests.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_
